I am not an easy person to deal with.  I have my own slew if issues and hangups.  So I would be doing a dishonor to those that never gave up on me, if I gave up on others.

Many of us long time nerds grew up when even liking a comic book was grounds for a broken nose.  When wearing glasses was enough to get you pushed off bleachers.  When you has to hide every one of your passions and mask daily just to survive.  Being a nerd used to be as bad as being gay.  I saw a friend of mine get his eye kicked out of his head.  I have seen friends get lit on fire.  For being a weirdo.

So back then the few friends you had, you fought tooth and nail for.  You accepted every eccentricity and they yours.  Cause it was the only community we could have.

You didn't give up on them.  You helped them as they found out they were gay.  You let them cry and be vulnerable when they had gotten beat up.  You told them there were other people and better people in their future when their crush laughed at them.  It didn't matter what political leanings they had, or what religion they were, if they were your friend, you never gave up on them.

I don't have a higher insult than thinking someone isn't worth my time, especially when they need me.  I try to give everyone every chance I can.  Any of you that know me from last season, or from other games.... you are all friends and worth what time I can.

To all the new people that I am just meeting, I hope you fit in and become part of this family.
